hub.speaker: Tier Clerk
hub.text: State your business and your sponsor.

text_variants.text: State your business. The tier doesn't sleep, and neither, apparently, do you.
A Human, this far in. State your business and your sponsor — twice, if the first answer doesn't hold up.
Papers, then, same as everyone through this gate. Sponsor's name, and don't waste my morning.
Posted rate, same as everyone. I don't set the price and I don't move it, whatever they taught you to say back home.

text_variants._comment: v0.15 T4.1 market ambient reactivity — same ordering rule as pallass_market_local.json's pair.
text_variants.text: You're carrying a forge-tier stamp. That's the permit office's business and not this window's. State whatever this window is for.
Liscor sends word that its seal is settled. Here that is one line in one dispatch, filed. State your business.

options.text: Papers for Pallass, filed and attuned. (2 gold)

stamped.speaker: Tier Clerk
stamped.text: Stamped. Market tier, until you've got cause for more. Mind the queues.
